name: image-browser

check.cmd: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && hash http-server > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo installed || echo uninstall

install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && export NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/node && hash node > /dev/null 2>&1 || nvm install --lts
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && hash npm > /dev/null 2>&1 && npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && hash http-server > /dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g http-server

description.zh: 图片浏览器：快速查看Pictures目录下的图片。
description.en: Image Browser is a quick tool for looking for pictures in ~/Pictures directory.
